spectral_proposal.adjacency_convention: A[v,u] for an observed u-to-v edge.
spectral_proposal.regularized_response: R_z=((zI-M)* (zI-M)+eta^2 I)^(-1) (zI-M)*; * is external complex adjoint.
spectral_proposal.score: For every required constraint anchor j, average |(R_z e_origin)[v]|^2 |(R_z* e_constraint_j)[v]|^2; take minimum over j, divided by estimated next-check cost.
spectral_proposal.claim_scope: Finite explicit heuristic; the expression-to-Teichmuller and circular-law bridges remain open.

exit: A later bounded run stops on witness, checked finite counterexample, failure or budget. Missing or truncated cells are retained as Unknown. This design schedules no run.
